description: Please join my team for the NASA space apps challenge. I am looking for member in the Hacathon and I want to help solve problems and want to build a Junior Astronaut Mission trainer for NASA. Thank you.
summary: This web simulation I built, called Sol Survivors, trains junior space astronauts to use their resources effectively to survive, thrive, and last long. This game teaches them how to ration, grow, and recycle water, food, oxygen, and their outpost's battery usage. Astronauts need to play this game before landing on Mars because they can't get hungry, thirsty, low on energy, or unhealthy; otherwise, the mission would be unsuccessful and over quickly. According to my research before starting the app, if you survive a sol, that means you survived a day on Mars. I think this game is very helpful to astronaut space training programs because while they physically train every day to withstand the harsh nature of space, they also have to be mentally strong and prepared so they can counter whatever is going to happen to them on another surface. I know that Mars is a dangerous environment, and it would give you nothing you would want to expect there, so this game will demonstrate the reality of the choices you make there. I always wanted to be an aerospace engineer for NASA and believe that I will get a scholarship in college to help me work there one day. This year's Hackathon helped me learn more about both advanced coding and the science of space. It also put my skills to the test and let me use the coding languages I already know that I used on this app, like HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.  I think this simulation will be useful to NASA one day, and every young astronaut will use it.
details: This simulation works by making decisions for the crew to help keep them alive on Mars. This game helps young astronauts become mentally smart, strong, and stable to help them to make the best decisions to keep them alive in Mars. This project uses HTML, CSS, and JavaScript as its coding languages. I use Visual Studio Code and GitHub as my coding software. My project is creative because the game is very entertaining; It makes people want to challenge themselves to play the game to see how many sols they can survive until they run out of health or resources. I considered factors in the game like limited oxygen, water, food, energy, health, protection, battery power, and more for the fictional crew in the game.
